pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal and irregular dark brown contiguous regions with moderate to sharp edge gradients against the inter-patch pathways. Geometries range from quadrilateral to complex multi-sided polygons with varied internal area on the shoulder and flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous topological graph of light-tan pathways. Pixel thickness varies across the network with distinct three-way and four-way junction nodes separating the dark patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Visible dark mane along the neck ridge displaying a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette against the background.
